objective: Freeze a small, non-overlapping execution order for the remaining Wave 3 work. No implementation is performed in this step.

executionRules.userCadence: One user 'Next' executes exactly one micro-step.
scopeCap: One focused verification pass, then stop.
If a micro-step expands unexpectedly, split it before implementation rather than continuing.
executionRules.deployment: Do not manually deploy after each micro-step while Vercel build-rate pressure remains. Commit cleanly to GitHub and report deployment status separately.
executionRules.research: Do not combine broad external research, large implementation and whole-site QA in one micro-step.
executionRules.overlapRule: A gap is owned by exactly one implementation step even if it affects multiple Wave 3 workstreams.

completedOrDeferred.3D: Referral lifecycle is complete for the current scope. Automatic government forwarding remains intentionally deferred.
completedOrDeferred.3F: Get Involved core submission/fallback workflow is complete; only cross-cutting fixes and QA remain.
completedOrDeferred.3H-low-volume-headline-metrics: Intentionally deferred until sample size and recency support meaningful public metrics.
completedOrDeferred.official-participation-calendar: Source-dependent. Keep the current honest empty-state/official-events handoff until a sufficiently authoritative current source exists.
completedOrDeferred.barangay-activity-comparisons: Do not build cross-barangay comparisons until Civic Map coverage and real submission volume are adequate.

batches.title: Complete the Participation Hub task set
batches.goal: Make /participate a complete citywide starting point without changing backend architecture.
changes: Expose public-place report/improvement as a citywide action, not only inside barangay scope.
Keep official participation, BetterMakati project input and Civic Map public-realm cases visibly distinct.
Ensure proposal, idea, source, correction, volunteer/contact and official-participation journeys are reachable without hunting.
batches.stopWhen: The task set is complete and every CTA points to an existing functional route/handoff.
excludes: Do not redesign Get Involved form.
Do not expand Civic Map assets.
Do not add new official opportunities.

batches.title: Preserve barangay context into Get Involved
batches.goal: Fix the one known scope-loss bug without broader form redesign.
changes: Read ?barangay= from the Get Involved URL.
Prefill the barangay/area field when valid context is supplied.
Preserve normal manual editing of that field.
Add a focused regression test from barangay-scoped Participation to Get Involved.
batches.stopWhen: A barangay-scoped source/correction journey reaches Get Involved with the barangay prefilled.
excludes: Do not create a new barangay submission backend.

batches.title: Add general-feedback duplicate detection
batches.goal: Reduce duplicate corrections, ideas, proposals and source submissions before creating another GitHub issue.
changes: Define conservative duplicate matching for /api/feedback.
Search only relevant open BetterMakati feedback issues.
Return an existing public issue reference when a strong duplicate is found.
Avoid fuzzy matching that could merge unrelated civic input.
batches.stopWhen: Strong duplicates reuse an existing issue; unrelated submissions still create a new one.

batches.title: Clarify duplicate-result UX
batches.goal: Make an existing-match response understandable without adding a separate workflow.
changes: Show when an existing public item was found.
Link to the existing tracking issue.
Retain the user's ability to continue only when the backend says the submission is not a strong duplicate.
batches.stopWhen: Duplicate responses are clearly distinguished from newly created submissions.
excludes: Do not redesign the entire submission form.

batches.title: Expand Civic Map government-service assets
batches.goal: Grow coverage using already-verifiable public facilities before harder transport/street research.
changes: Add a bounded batch of verified public offices, health centers and community-facing public facilities.
Reuse existing BetterMakati government/barangay facility data where coordinates or reliable locations already exist.
Keep asset metadata and barangay assignment sourceable.
batches.stopWhen: One coherent facility batch is added and validated; do not continue to another asset family in the same step.
batches.revisionReason: Apply the Makati-publication-first methodology: inventory official Makati public infrastructure/facility lists before treating the initial four-facility batch as complete.

previousPreliminaryBatch.disposition: retain assets; audit against official Makati infrastructure/facility inventories before closure

revisedMethodology: Extract named public infrastructure/facility inventories from Makati Facts & Figures, Basic Facts, Citizen's Charters and department publications.
Reconcile historical/current geography and operating status.
Implement verified missing current assets in bounded families.
Close only when every official-inventory item has a disposition.

batches.title: Complete Makati parks and civic-space coverage
batches.goal: Reconcile Makati's official park inventories against current 23-barangay geography, implement all verified current public parks, then separately complete private/public-access parks.
changes: Add verified parks, community spaces, markets or public toilets only where location/source confidence is sufficient.
Apply the existing rating criteria appropriate to each asset type.
batches.stopWhen: The civic-space batch is complete and verified.
batches.revisionReason: Official Makati sources publish much broader public-park inventories. The previous three-park CBD batch is retained as preliminary private/public-access coverage, not completion.

previousPreliminaryBatch.disposition: retain assets; reclassify within revised public/private park framework

batches.title: Research verified public-transport objects
batches.goal: Establish a reliable source set for transport stops, terminals and routes before adding them to the map.
changes: Inventory authoritative or reliably maintained Makati transport sources.
Identify which route/stop objects can be represented without false precision.
Freeze a source-backed transport expansion list.
batches.stopWhen: A source-backed transport expansion list exists.
excludes: Do not add transport assets in the same research step.
batches.revisionReason: Apply the Makati-publication-first methodology: Makati publications report transport inventories and counts beyond the already-added MRT/Busway/One Ayala assets.

previousTransportWork.disposition: retain the eight verified transport assets; audit them and missing objects against Makati publications before closure
evidenceExamples: Makati Facts and Figures 2020 includes transportation modes, public utility jeep routes and ferry station sections.
Makati City Basic Facts and Figures 2023 reports 4 MRT stations, 3 PNR stations and 32 bus stops, excluding the 10 transferred barangays.

revisedMethodology: Reconcile them to current operators, current routes/stops and present-day 23-barangay geography.
Preserve official-city inventory provenance separately from operator/current-network verification.
Add missing verified current transport assets only after the crosswalk is complete.

batches.title: Add verified transport assets
batches.goal: Implement only the transport objects approved in 3C-3.
changes: Add verified routes/stops/terminals in small source-coherent batches.
Use existing transport-specific issue and rating categories.
batches.stopWhen: The first approved transport batch is implemented and validated.
batches.splitRule: If the approved list is large, continue as 3C-4a, 3C-4b, etc., one source family per user 'Next'.
batches.splitReason: Implement rail/intermodal assets first; add busway stations separately after distinct mode-specific points are verified.

batches.title: Define participation outcome metrics
batches.goal: Define measurable response/conversion/outcome fields before collecting or publishing them.
changes: Define what counts as received, reviewed, responded, converted to action and resolved for each participation workflow.
Keep general BetterMakati feedback metrics separate from Civic Map case metrics where semantics differ.
Define minimum-volume rules before any public rate/percentage is shown.
batches.stopWhen: Metric definitions and publication thresholds are frozen.
excludes: Do not publish headline metrics in this step.

batches.title: Instrument participation timestamps and outcomes
batches.goal: Collect the fields required by 3H-1 without creating dashboards yet.
changes: Add or derive timestamps/status fields needed for response-time and conversion measurement.
Preserve existing public GitHub tracking model.
batches.stopWhen: The machine data exposes the defined fields with no public aggregate claims yet.

batches.title: Add missing participation pages to human audit
batches.goal: Bring all major participation surfaces under the existing page-freshness discipline.
changes: Add /get-involved to page-audit.json.
Add /civic-map/reports to page-audit.json.
Add /contact to page-audit.json.
Give each a real checklist, review date and explicit known gaps.
batches.stopWhen: All major participation surfaces are covered by page audit and dependency-aware freshness.
batches.note: Scheduled late so audit rows describe the stabilized Wave 3 implementation rather than moving targets.

batches.title: Add participation-depth architecture audit
batches.goal: Create one build audit that protects the participation architecture without duplicating browser tests.
changes: Guard required routes and API endpoints.
Guard emergency routing, duplicate semantics, barangay context, lifecycle distinctions and canonical submission paths.
Reject accidental merging of general feedback and Civic Map case semantics.
batches.stopWhen: The audit runs in quality/build and catches the Wave 3 architectural invariants.

batches.title: Test general participation submission journeys
batches.goal: Add focused browser/API coverage for Get Involved and general feedback.
changes: Test type/tool/subject/barangay prefill.
Test successful submission response shape.
Test duplicate-result behavior.
Test fallback behavior when native storage is unavailable.
Test correction entry from a normal page.
batches.stopWhen: General BetterMakati input has end-to-end regression coverage.

batches.title: Test Civic Map lifecycle journeys
batches.goal: Cover the public-realm path separately from general feedback.
changes: Test report/proposal submission validation.
Test emergency rejection/911 handoff.
Test duplicate-case handoff.
Test corroboration/referral eligibility data.
Test lifecycle status rendering without implying government acknowledgement prematurely.
batches.stopWhen: Civic Map's submission and lifecycle semantics have focused regression coverage.

batches.title: Participation mobile/accessibility pass
batches.goal: Finish Wave 3 with targeted mobile, keyboard, focus, label and error-state QA.
changes: Check /participate, /get-involved, /civic-map, representative asset page, /civic-map/reports and /contact at 390px.
Run Axe coverage for those routes/states.
Check form labels, focus order, errors and touch targets.
Fix only participation-specific defects discovered.
likelyFiles: participation components only if a defect is found
batches.stopWhen: Targeted participation QA passes and no Wave 3-specific accessibility/mobile defect remains.

batches.title: Close Wave 3
batches.goal: Re-run the Wave 3 classification and close only what is actually complete.
changes: Reclassify all 40 capabilities.
Refresh participation page-audit gaps.
Record source-dependent and intentionally deferred items without treating them as implementation failures.
Freeze the Wave 3 completion record.
batches.stopWhen: Wave 3 completion state is evidence-based and the next major wave can start.

whyThisOrder: Fix user routing and lost barangay context before adding more participation volume.
Add general-feedback deduplication before instrumenting participation outcomes.
Expand Civic Map coverage in bounded asset families instead of one citywide data push.
Define metrics before collecting or publishing them.
Do final audit/E2E/mobile/accessibility work after the functional behavior is stable.
Keep source-dependent and intentionally deferred items out of the active implementation queue.

removedAsDuplicateOrDeferred.disposition: Coverage work is owned by 3C-1 through 3C-4. Barangay activity comparisons remain deferred until the underlying map/submission density exists.
Split by backend semantics into 3I-3 general participation and 3I-4 Civic Map.

immediateNext.title: Verify current public parks
immediateNext.maximumScope: Research/verification only: current status, current name, access/ownership, barangay/address, and coordinate provenance. No Civic Map implementation yet.
